body.x: Samsung Electronics(www.samsung.com/sec) unveiled 'Glasses 3D UHD TV 55"' at 'CES 2014', the biggest ITappliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

Company explained "Sanmsung's Smart TV is even easier, faster and more fun to use. The new Multi-Link feature brings contextual multitasking to the big screen, enabling users to go deeper into their enterainment by splitting the screen to bring up related contact to enhance the viewing experience."

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500~3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
